findings.message: An interactive new/reschedule mode switcher is exposed in the form body even though it is not part of the page layout. It reads like an internal segmented/debug control, lets the user flip the form's mode without any appointment context, competes with the title and the single save CTA, and in the disabled state becomes an inert decoration. Proposal: Remove the mode chips. Show the mode only as read-only context in the header or as a subdued caption (e.g. '改期 · 张女士 · 11-05 10:00'), and keep one save CTA whose label reflects the mode.
findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-form.default.png — immediately below the '新增/改期预约' back bar and above the 客户 field: a filled dark '新增预约' chip next to an outlined '改期' chip; the same pair remains in appointment-form.state.disabled.png and appointment-form.mode.reschedule.png.

findings.message: The default schedule presents three conflicting date signals (filter '全部', grid week of 11-02, list group 11-05) and marks no column as today, with no active-date label above the grid. The core orientation cue of a schedule is missing, so users cannot tell which day they are looking at. Proposal: Derive both views from one selected date, default it to today, label the active date above the grid, apply a clear today-column highlight, and make the 日期 filter show the same selected value.
findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-list.default.png — calendar header row (周一 2026-11-02 / 周二 2026-11-03 / 周三 2026-11-04) and the 日期 filter above it showing '全部'; no day header or column carries a today highlight; screenshots/appointment-list.view.list.png groups the same rows under '11-05 周三'.

findings.message: The loading state replaces the entire calendar chrome with generic stacked placeholders, so the controls disappear and the whole layout shifts when data arrives; it does not preserve the seven-column grid structure the spec requires, and loading looks unrelated to the loaded page. Proposal: Keep the real filter row, view toggle and legend visible, and render a calendar-shaped skeleton with the seven day columns and time gutter so only block content shimmers.
findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-list.state.loading.png — content area below the '预约列表' back bar: only three generic rounded gray slabs; the 状态/日期 filters, the 切换日历/列表 button, the status legend and the seven-column time grid are all absent.

findings.message: The empty state collapses the calendar grid, so the legend labels nothing, the structure jumps when users change filters/views, and the empty message is small and unanchored. The state also offers no way to clear the status/date filters that caused it. Proposal: Retain the seven-column grid and time axis with an inline empty block or overlay, and place an icon + title + description + secondary '清空筛选' action inside the calendar area using the same empty-state pattern as other pages.
findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-list.state.empty.png — center of the content area: the 已登记/已到店/爽约/已取消 legend remains, below it the two lines '当前条件没有预约 / 调整筛选条件后重试' float in a large blank region with no icon; the calendar grid and time axis are gone and there is no clear-filter action.

findings.message: The reschedule state shows no record context: the locked customer is blank and the rest of the appointment is not restored, so the screen is visually indistinguishable from a blank new form except for the CTA. The locked customer control therefore communicates neither who is being rescheduled nor when. Proposal: Prefill and lock the customer identity (name + masked phone), restore project/time/therapist from the appointment, and add a compact context line for the original slot; if the record is still loading, show the reschedule skeleton instead of an empty form.
findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-form.mode.reschedule.png — 客户 field (first field): grayed, showing the empty placeholder '请输入客户' with a grayed 选择 button; 项目/开始时间/结束时间/护理师 are also empty placeholders, while the footer CTA reads '保存改期'.

findings.message: The card lacks the specified '查看全部' entry, so the section header has no route to the full appointment list and the header's right side reads as dead space next to rows that do have chevrons. Proposal: Add a low-emphasis '查看全部 ›' text action at the card header's top-right, aligned with the card's inner padding.
findings.evidence: screenshots/today.default.png — '我的预约' card header, right side of the card title (~y=215): only the title is present; the header has no '查看全部' action even though three appointment rows are listed below.

findings.message: Two empty states on the same page use different icon containers and vertical treatment, so the same component looks like two different patterns and the page loses rhythm. Proposal: Use one EmptyState layout for both blocks (same icon tile size/tone, title/description spacing, optional action slot) and normalize the block padding.
findings.evidence: screenshots/today.state.empty.png — '我的预约' empty block (upper card, centered): event icon inside a 48px rounded gray tile; '待回访' empty block (lower card): call icon rendered bare with no tile, with different internal spacing and no action.

findings.message: The disabled save CTA loses almost all contrast, so the footer reads as empty and the unavailability of saving is conveyed only by the top banner; the disabled state of the control is not visually intelligible. Proposal: Keep a clearly visible disabled footer button (de-emphasized surface, muted but legible label, optional lock cue) and tie it to the reason, e.g. '保存（无新增预约权限）'.
findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-form.state.disabled.png — fixed bottom bar: the disabled primary '保存' button is a white pill with a very light border and pale gray label against the white footer; it nearly disappears.

findings.message: The date-time fields use a US-English order and AM/PM placeholder in an otherwise Chinese UI, while appointment detail and list display dates as '2026-11-01 15:20' or '11-05 周三'. The format clash looks unlocalized and makes the expected input unclear. Proposal: Localize the datetime inputs to yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm (or reuse the app's picker/format) and use a Chinese hint such as '请选择开始时间'.
findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-form.default.png — 开始时间/结束时间 inputs in the middle of the form: placeholders read 'mm/dd/yyyy, --:-- --'; the same appears in appointment-form.mode.reschedule.png.

findings.message: For an arrived appointment 开单 is the primary next step, but as the only footer action it is styled as a low-emphasis outline button, so the footer reads as secondary/disabled and the page provides no clear primary CTA. Proposal: Promote 开单 to the primary filled style when it is the only footer action (or pair it with an appropriate secondary), keeping the footer hierarchy consistent across business states.
findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-detail.business.已到店.png — fixed bottom action bar (~y=798): only '开单' is present, rendered as a white outlined secondary button spanning the bar, the same low-emphasis treatment used for disabled/secondary actions elsewhere.
